aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The expect_to_spawn dependency is the primary signal because SpawnBase public state is highly sensitive to stale searcher and Expecter matching semantics.
The transport_to_spawn dependency captures stale assumptions around command parsing, executable lookup, interrupt-safe polling, read_nonblocking, EOF/TIMEOUT, CRLF, and output type behavior.
The spawn_to_wrappers dependency captures stale assumptions in run, replwrap, and async wrappers.
Revision v0.3.2 closes the dependency scope over the stripped process utilities already exercised by public tests.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Expecter and searcher matching semantics must be stable for SpawnBase.expect, expect_exact, before/after/match, buffer, and searchwindowsize behavior.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when expect/search ordering, buffer state, and search window probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The SpawnBase agent may update before/after/match or buffer state around stale searcher return semantics or search window assumptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Process utilities plus pty and popen transports must present command parsing, executable lookup, interrupt-safe polling, read_nonblocking, EOF, TIMEOUT, bytes/text, and CRLF behavior that SpawnBase and Expecter consume consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when transport probes and SpawnBase EOF/TIMEOUT consumer probes pass together after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: SpawnBase or Expecter code may assume stale transport output type, line ending, EOF, or timeout behavior.

dependency_points.contract_summary: run, replwrap, and async wrappers must consume SpawnBase expect/read behavior, EOF/TIMEOUT handling, callback events, and transport output normalization consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when SpawnBase/transport expect probes and run/replwrap/async wrapper probes pass in the final integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: Wrapper code may duplicate or bypass stale SpawnBase semantics, causing callbacks or async wrappers to disagree with expect behavior.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Pexpect expect/search, SpawnBase state, transport, run, and async wrapper contracts.
